title: Core: AS2 anonymous functions and closures
description: Test compilation of: anonymous function expressions (var fn = function(){}), immediately-invoked function expressions (IIFE): (function(){})(), closures that capture outer variables: function outer() { var x = 1; return function inner() { return x; }; }, callback patterns: arr.forEach(function(item) { trace(item); }). Verify ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) for each, and that captured variables are accessible.
